rules.caseIsolation: One output per selected person case; a group session never merges case status
rules.assignment: Trainer comes from the linked persisted session; participant comes from the person case; owner tasks use MATT
rules.evidence: Only accepted response IDs and verified archive status may advance the suggested action
rules.authorization: This projection is read-only and canExecute is always false; the action endpoint must re-read evidence and verify caller identity and assignment
rules.freshness: No cached link or projection grants a write; re-read persisted rows immediately before each action
rules.conflict: Missing assignment or contradictory completed evidence produces blocked audit_review
